name: @pg-prime/bench-compare
description: design/08 §5's comparison run: the nine end-to-end cases against drizzle-orm and kysely, on the same PostgreSQL and through the SAME `pg` pool, in one interleaved process. Nightly only — a wall-clock comparison on a shared runner competing with a test suite measures the suite. The competitors' dependencies live HERE and nowhere else: they must not reach the root or `packages/*`, which is what `pnpm lint`'s sherif and knip steps check.
